summary: Introduced Venues as a core domain. Implemented venue catalog, discovery, and integration with the Games feature across API, Web, and Mobile. Successfully seeded initial Seoul-based venues and enabled users to attach venues to games during creation.

environment_readiness.infra_evidence: PostgreSQL and Redis containers are healthy.

major_decisions.decision: Included category, amenities, and many-to-many relationship with Sports.
major_decisions.reason: Provides rich metadata for discovery and ensures venues only show up for relevant sports.

major_decisions.decision: Used a combination of findFirst by name and update/create for idempotency.
major_decisions.reason: Ensures seed script can be run multiple times without creating duplicates even as IDs are UUIDs.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Name must be unique in the initial seed set.

major_decisions.decision: Made venueId optional in Game model and included venue detail in game response.
major_decisions.reason: Allows flexibility for games at non-canonical locations (homeArea only) while providing rich data for venue-based games.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Increased complexity in game detail responses.

tests.name: Venues API tests
tests.notes: Verified list, filter by sport, and detail retrieval.

tests.name: Game-Venue Integration test
tests.notes: Verified game creation with venueId and detail retrieval with venue info.

acceptance_checklist.evidence: Implemented VenuesListScreen and VenuesListPage with search.
Games can reference venueId; tests verify linkage.

errors.error: Unexpected any in venues route and test.
errors.how_fixed_or_next_steps: Used Prisma.VenueWhereInput and specific types to remove any.

next_recommendations: Add map integration (Google/Naver Maps) using mapLink and future lat/lng fields.
Introduce venue-specific rules (e.g., operating hours, parking capacity).
api_contract_changes: Updated /games to include venueId and return venue object
